method: Reviewed the three active public game entries and loaded gameplay/UI modules. Inspected Moratales main menu, fresh character, area guide and all backpack tabs; Manager setup and Central, Squad/tactics/training/dynamics/youth/archive, Transfers, Season, Office and Matchday; Morogue main menu, Journal, Combat guide, Evolutions, Bestiary/worlds, Night pantry, Wardrobe and Options. Story-gated screens and catalogue rules were checked in their active public source. This is not a complete playthrough of every story or every possible save state.

coverage.Moratales: Travel regions, village districts and shops; opening hours, calendar/seasons, controls, quests and story routes, coffee/roasting, staff/wages, café displays/pricing/rent, furniture/storage, co-op, energy, all 44 crops, 88 recipes, 76 supplier ingredients, 42 resident entries and 50 potential colleagues.
coverage.Velmora Manager: Career navigation and starting paths, player career, club selection, all 288 club setup profiles and four world profiles, squad/tactics/dynamics/training/youth, scouting/transfers/budget allocation, matchday, cups/records/archive, office/board/staff/contracts, online career and local/cloud save guidance.
coverage.Morogue: Menus, controls/options, modes, permanent pantry upgrades, currency, evolutions/pickups, rerolls, merchant, leaderboard rules, all 30 worlds, 20 ordinary enemy types, six events, 18 cosmetics, six specials, 53 perks, four keystones, 55 merchant relics, conditional build calculations and boss guides.
coverage.Demos: Brief current catalogue and play guidance for Broomflight, Dragonbound, Repo Diver, Goblin Bomb Party, Repo Rooftops, High Seas, Repo Sports and Repo Runners; approved historical Repo Sports World Cup material remains available.
coverage.Account: Sign-in, friends/privacy, RepoScore versus Repoints, achievements, packs, inventory visibility, card/slab binders.
coverage.Wibs: Channels/DMs, voice controls, screen sharing, GIF playback, usage, themes/layout and activity.
coverage.Wibsworth: Host identity, capabilities, daily allowance, opt-in preferences, local conversation history, source checking and developer-reviewed corrections.
coverage.Reparty: Rooms, links/queue/playlists/chat, personal versus room playback controls, switching workspaces, resizing the player and room members.

naming: Morogue public food-card names take precedence over older internal combat names. The latter are retrieval aliases only. Relic coverage uses the current 55-item catalogue installed by relic-cards.js, not the obsolete twelve-card presentation list.
inference: Game/site passages and calculations are returned directly from reviewed evidence. Qwen3 1.7B handles open conversation/general knowledge. This avoids observed errors where the small model inverted correct supplied facts.
knownLimits: General knowledge can still be wrong. No live web search or external paid provider fallback.
Build comparisons preserve conditions, costs and trade-offs; they are not a proof of a universal highest-DPS build.
A displayed online feature is not proof its external service is currently available.
No access to members' private messages, game saves, inventories or balances.
No unreviewed assets, unreleased material or automatically learned member claims.
A finite reviewed library cannot guarantee every future question. Game changes require a new review; source checks fail on drift. Normal answers discuss one game without platform qualifiers.
maintenance: Source pin tests fail on changed local content; --verify-published checks remote bytes and active game script references. Review changed facts before updating pins. A fact suggestion remains pending even when related published source bytes match. Approving a correction requires a current Developer role.
conversationReview: Reproduced the member's misspelled Repo Company introduction and repeated Morogue overview on an upgrades follow-up. Query-only product matching now tolerates one insertion, deletion, substitution or adjacent transposition in distinctive names; stored product validation remains exact. Broad Morogue upgrade, weapon, passive, perk, relic, special and keystone questions use category guides, while named-item and build advice stay separate. Game overviews no longer substitute for specific unanswered questions. Handler tests replay a continuous introduction/upgrades/permanent bonuses/weapons/perks/named perk/relics/named relic/specials/keystones/passives conversation without a model connection.
appInstallReview: Reviewed the phone install instructions and Phone/Desktop Download chooser. Added verified iPhone and Android installation guidance; reviewed profile/Wibs artwork-only changes without changing game facts. Account login remains username/password with approved email invitations.
callControlsReview: Reviewed icon call controls, automatic remote webcam viewing and per-person Hide/Show webcam with server-filtered subscriptions. Publishing remains opt-in, the shared 950 GB limit and one-hour camera expiry remain enforced. Reviewed phone viewport sizing without changing install instructions.
